## Analysis

**Comparability:** Amazon's fiscal years 2022–2024 are all calendar years ending December 31, reported on the same consolidated basis in the same filing, so the two growth rates are directly comparable (no spinoff, divestiture, or fiscal-calendar mismatch affecting the comparison) [DOC: amzn_growth.txt — Amazon.com, Inc. Form 10-K FY2024, accession 0001018724-25-000004, consolidated statements of operations].

**Net sales** [DOC: amzn_growth.txt — FY2022 $513,983M; FY2023 $574,785M; FY2024 $637,959M]:

| Fiscal year | Net sales ($M) | YoY growth |
|---|---|---|
| FY2022 | 513,983 | — |
| FY2023 | 574,785 | +11.8% |
| FY2024 | 637,959 | +11.0% |

- FY2023: 574,785 / 513,983 − 1 = **+11.83%**
- FY2024: 637,959 / 574,785 − 1 = **+10.99%**
- Change: **−0.84 percentage points**

**Interpretation:** Growth decelerated, but only marginally — under one percentage point. In absolute dollars, revenue actually expanded more in FY2024 (+$63.2B) than in FY2023 (+$60.8B); the lower percentage simply reflects the larger revenue base. This is best characterized as a modest deceleration on a broadly stable low-double-digit growth trajectory, rather than a meaningful slowdown. (Note: the excerpt provided does not include constant-currency figures, so this is a reported-basis comparison only.)

ANSWER: Decelerated slightly — growth slowed from ~11.8% in FY2023 to ~11.0% in FY2024 (−0.8 pp), essentially a stable low-double-digit growth rate
